description: Source code implementing ASN.1 certificate parsing utilities, including functions to extract subject, SPKI, extensions, and signature algorithms from DER-encoded X.509 certificates.

methods.name: SeekToSubject
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded certificate to position the parser at the subject field.

methods.name: SeekToSPKI
methods.description: Positions the parser at the SubjectPublicKeyInfo section of a certificate.

methods.name: SeekToExtensions
methods.description: Positions the parser at the Extensions section of a certificate if present.

methods.name: ExtractExtensionWithOID
methods.description: Extracts a specific extension from a DER-encoded certificate by OID.

methods.name: ExtractSubjectFromDERCert
methods.description: Extracts the subject field from a DER-encoded certificate.

methods.name: ExtractSPKIFromDERCert
methods.description: Extracts the SubjectPublicKeyInfo from a DER-encoded certificate.

methods.name: ExtractSubjectPublicKeyFromSPKI
methods.description: Extracts the public key bits from a SubjectPublicKeyInfo structure.

methods.name: HasCanSignHttpExchangesDraftExtension
methods.description: Checks if a certificate has the canSignHttpExchangesDraft extension with NULL content.

methods.name: ExtractSignatureAlgorithmsFromDERCert
methods.description: Extracts the signature algorithm sequences from a DER-encoded certificate.

methods.name: ExtractExtensionFromDERCert
methods.description: Extracts specific extension data, criticality, and presence from a DER-encoded certificate.
